reviews.text: Dr. Costa is always beautiful, smart, courteous, and an expert at removing anxiety. Thank you.
They've been my trusted veterinarians for over 30 years. I have complete confidence in them.

Everyone was extremely knowledgeable, especially Dr. Costa, who diagnosed my dog ​​with Addison's disease at 7 months old, with symptoms that hadn't been properly evaluated in other settings. Since then, my Mora's life (and outlook) has completely changed! Thank you.

Excellent veterinarians, competent, professional, humane and not at all mercenary. I first treated a 16-year-old cat, then a 17-year-old poodle and now the other dogs. Complete respect and trust. Mario Cacciapuoti and Elisabetta Costa, 2 excellent veterinarians and surgeons who think only of the animal's well-being and the most advantageous choice for him, never thinking about money. Those who make their work a mission... I grew up with them... And I hope they stay for a long time. To continue together with the dogs... I highly recommend them... humane and very good even the 2 groomers... Excellent clinic...

Excellent veterinary clinic
But above all, passion and dedication to the profession.
